name: prompt-upgrade
description: /improve <prompt>: a pane asks 2-4 clickable questions about what you want, then writes a fuller prompt you can run, edit or copy. Two small model calls per upgrade, only when you ask.

model.title: Model for questions and rewrite
model.description: The model prompt-upgrade asks for its questions and writes the upgraded prompt with: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id.
